nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 collateral asset held in custody by the CollateralLocker.
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to pull collateral.
Constructor that sets collateralAsset and loan immutable state variables.
External isLoan-guarded function transferring an amount of collateral asset to a destination.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the loan address.
Caller-controlled address used to gate access to pull().
External ERC20 safeTransfer call forwarding control to the collateral token contract.
Constructor parameter for the collateral asset address.
Constructor parameter for the loan contract address.
Destination address for the collateral transfer in pull().
Amount of collateral asset to transfer in pull().

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _collateralAsset is assigned to the collateralAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter _loan is assigned to the loan state variable.
The isLoan modifier compares caller-controlled msg.sender against the stored loan address to gate access.
The loan state variable is the trusted value read by the isLoan modifier for the msg.sender check.
The isLoan modifier controls whether execution reaches the pull function.
msg.sender determines whether the caller may invoke the privileged pull function.
pull() invokes the collateralAsset.safeTransfer external token call.
The dst parameter is passed as the recipient of the external safeTransfer call.
The amt parameter is passed as the value of the external safeTransfer call.
The external token transfer can transfer control to an attacker-controlled token contract, enabling reentrant callback into pull before state settles.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter dst is consumed directly by the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
Parameter amt is consumed directly by the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
